exposedSide.description: Rules for when a side of a box is exposed.

boxSide.description: Rules for when a side of a box is adjacent to another box.

wallSide.description: Rules for when a side of a box is adjacent to a wall.

exposedOrOuterLaminate.description: Used on all sides if the panel is exposed or has outer laminate.

notExposedOrInnerLaminate.description: Used if the panel is not exposed or has inner laminate.

slidingDoorException.description: Outer edges of sliding doors use 2mm edge banding.

vbFittings.description: VB fittings are used for fastening two planks. Hole on side panel is centered on top/bottom planks.

screwFittings.description: Screws are used for fastening. Screw hole is centered on the thickness of the adjacent plank.

doorRules.description: 1mm clearance is left on all sides of the door.
